subject: Render DELTA8 plan: backboardd-only inert, bounded traces, path preserve
body:
Read DELTA8 and current board. Planned render-owned changes; no shared header/API edit needed.

1. Inert runtime scope: render_pipeline.inc will call the existing static compute helper tegu_process_is_backboardd() (same translation unit; host test sets tegu_host_process_backboardd). When TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES is compiled in, inert nonnil pipelines are returned only when that helper is true; all other processes keep nil/NSError. Flag-off behavior unchanged. I will wrap the process check in a render-local tegu_render_inert_pipeline_allowed() rather than add a new shared declaration.

2. Traces: first128 inert pipelines get exactly TEGU_INERT_PIPELINE v=<fn> f=<fn> fmt=<comma-separated descriptor colour formats> reason=<bounded compile/admission message>; no trace when inert is not returned. Existing TEGU_INERT_DRAW_REFUSED becomes first32 per process (pipeline name/reason retained). Host tests both flag states and backboardd true/false.

3. path_* descriptor masks: after the full MULTI_TARGET probe, use the compiler plan written mask. For path_* only, unwritten active attachments become preserved: single written target switches to per-RT v3 at that target; contiguous written outputs keep v4 with the target count capped at the highest written index; noncontiguous written masks switch to per-RT for the written targets. Preserved target clear jobs are removed and endEncoding does not re-clear them. Non-path mask mismatch still refuses. Host fixture: path_cubic with four active masks while shader writes only RT2 -> status4, only RT2 clear+draw.

4. path_blit true-MRT+fetch: exact snapshot is not currently supported by the bridge, so the pipeline will be admitted as inert in backboardd (explicit reason), not a generic pipeline whose draw later invalidates the command. Non-backboardd remains nil/error. No direct target sampling or dropped fetch.

I will edit render_pipeline.inc/render_encoder.inc only plus worker tests. No compute/n2r/bridge edits. FREEZE/lease respected; no phone/native/publish/commit. If compute intends an exact true-MRT fetch snapshot, send the contract before I finalize item4.
